scenes.say: They're late because they're irresponsible. You're late because of traffic. Convenient.
The fundamental attribution error: we blame other people's character, and our own circumstances.
You see your own situation in full detail. Theirs is invisible.
So you judge too fast, and learn the wrong lesson from other people's failures.
Before judging someone, ask what situation would make a normal person do exactly the same.
